h1: 30A Beach Retreat: Grill, Bikes & Pool Access
meta_description: Book 30A Beach Retreat: Grill, Bikes & Pool Access directly on LocalVR for the best rates. No third-party fees. This bright and welcoming 30A vacation rental offers an ideal location, minutes from the beach and close to community amenities like 2 pools, a hot tub, sports ...
description_expanded: SummaryThis bright and welcoming 30A vacation rental offers an ideal location, minutes from the beach and close to community amenities like 2 pools, a hot tub, sports courts, and scenic trails. Inside, enjoy a cozy living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bonus room for extra lounging space. With 4 spacious bedrooms, a screened-in porch, 4 bikes, and BBQ grill this home has everything you need for a memorable 30A getaway.SpaceLocation perks: NatureWalk Lilly Lane Beach Trail (0.5 miles), Seagrove Beach (2.3 miles), Seaside Central Square (2.9 miles), Grayton Beach State Park (4.1 miles), Rosemary Beach (13.2 miles) Interior: - Fully equipped kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, air fryer, blender, cooking utensils, tableware) - 6 Smart TVs with cable (55” in the living room) - Full-size washer and dryer - Free Wi-Fi - Central heating and A/C - 2,152 sq. ft. Exterior: - Screened-in porch (upper level) - Outdoor seating - 4 bikes - Gas BBQ - On-site parking for 3 vehicles (in the alley driveway) - Parking in front of house (first come, first served) Community: - Hot tub - 2 Pools (lap pool heated year-round, kids pool) - Playground - Dual pickleball/basketball court - Walking trail with fitness stops - Beach trail access Upper Floor: Bonus room, 3 bedrooms, 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 full bathroom Main Floor: Living room, kitchen, dining room, 1 bedroom, 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 half bath Nestled in the sought-after NatureWalk community, this inviting 4-bedroom retreat blends coastal charm with comfort, perfect for families and groups. The open main level includes a fully equipped kitchen with updated appliances, a large dining area for shared meals, and a cozy living room with plush seating and a Smart TV. Upstairs, a bonus room adds more space to relax, featuring a sleeper sofa and a second Smart TV for movie nights or downtime. Designed to host up to 12 guests, the home offers a peaceful master suite with a king bed, private en-suite bath, and walk-in closet, plus two additional king bedrooms and a bunk room with three twin beds. Outdoors, unwind on the screened-in porch, grill out with the gas BBQ, or hop on the bikes to explore the area. Community amenities, including two pools (one heated year-round), a hot tub, pickleball courts, and scenic walking trails, are just steps from your door. With Seaside, Grayton Beach State Park, and the popular 30A bike path only minutes away, this home makes an excellent base for your 30A escape!NeighborhoodNestled in the desirable NatureWalk community, this home combines coastal charm with modern convenience, surrounded by lush state parks, rare dune lakes, and just minutes from the white sands of Seagrove Beach. This peaceful area places you close to 30A favorites like Seaside, known for its pastel cottages, boutique shops, and iconic Airstream food trucks, as well as the scenic trails of Grayton Beach State Park. From this home, enjoy easy access to bike and walking trails that connect to nearby attractions, dining, and entertainment. Catch live music at The Hub, go dolphin-watching, or paddleboard on Western Lake. Just a short drive away, Camp Helen State Park offers fishing, kayaking, and scenic views of Lake Powell. From beach days to seafood dining, this location is the perfect gateway to experiencing the best of 30A.TransitLocated in the desirable NatureWalk community, this home is perfectly positioned for exploring 30A. Bicycles are a popular way to get around, and with 4 bikes included, guests have everything needed for easy exploration. Nearby attractions include Seaside and WaterColor, each about 10 minutes away, and Grayton Beach State Park, which is around 12 minutes by car. During peak summer, the free 30A Trolley provides convenient stops along the main route.AccessGuests will have access to the entire home and parking for up to 3 vehicles in the private driveway off the alley. Parking in front of the house is first come, first served. They can also enjoy a variety of community amenities, including a hot tub, 2 outdoor pools, a pickleball/basketball court, a playground, and a walking trail with fitness stations.NotesPlease note that the Gathering Place will be closed for a major pool resurfacing project from Monday, January 27th, to the end of February. Badge access will be turned off, and closure notices will be posted on both gate accesses. NO Commercial Vehicles, Trailers, RVs, or Vehicles over 240” are allowed per HOA guidelines. House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted.Read Less
